<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/publish_catalog/{local_name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Commits whatever the catalog currently holds and pushes it.

Open to any catalog whose repository accepts changes from this grid, not
only one created here: a catalog installed on several grids has one
repository, and whichever of them the maintainer is sitting at is where
the changes are. Write access is confirmed with a test push the first
time, so a read-only subscription still cannot reach this.

Validated with the *same* checks a subscriber runs on pull, before the push
rather than after: publishing content that every subscriber would then
refuse is a failure that belongs here, where the person who can fix it is
standing, rather than in a customer's support ticket.
